_about: Hand-written tags for the ChatGPT find_practice tool — ADAPTIVE practices only (the free set, also on onda-life.com/emoton). DRAFT — awaiting Yakiv's review. goals: calm | sleep | focus | energy (1–2, first = main). level: beginner | occasional | regular. setting: anywhere | sitting | standing | lying | moving. line: one honest sentence, no medical claims. Name, emoji, duration and emotion come from landing/src/data/adaptivePractices.ts at build time; only these fields live here.

body_cocoon.line: Hug yourself and breathe out slowly to feel safe when anxiety spikes.

roots_breath.line: Breathe in to the chest and out into the feet to drain off anxious tension.

earth_pulse.line: Hands on chest and belly, find the calmest pace of your breath and heartbeat.

earth_breath.line: Standing breath that rises to the chest and settles into the ground.

wave_pulse.line: Feel your pulse and let the breath rise and fall with it like a wave.

still_form.line: Hold a simple, stable pose and let the breath run on its own.

slow_glow.line: Slow, soft breathing with a gentle warm image to wind down when tired.

rest_breath.line: Exhale about twice as long as the inhale to let the body sink into rest.

warm_sphere.line: Gather warmth in the belly and spread it through the body when you feel drained.

light_inhale.line: A light, uplifting breath that spreads a warm feeling through the body.

inner_smile.line: Relax the face and jaw and let a soft inner smile spread through you.

amoeba_dance.line: Tiny swaying movements on the breath to let a good mood move the body.

inner_spark.line: Name your intention and gather attention into one warm point before you start something.

light_flow.line: Sit tall and imagine light rising along the spine to wake up.

breath_possibility.line: Inhale ‘I accept’, exhale ‘I can’ — a short reset before a choice or a hard task.

silence_point.line: Eyes closed, rest attention on a still point and breathe around it.

listen_space.line: Open your hearing and notice the pauses between sounds.

sphere_breath.line: Imagine a sphere around you that expands on the inhale and gathers on the exhale.
